deviations.what: The original controller loads the shared demo products.json and the List uses binding="{/ProductCollection/0}" to element-bind a single record; abap2UI5 serves one default model, so the record is flattened to top-level default-model fields (name/productid/productpicurl = products.json row 0, Notebook Basic 15 / HT-1000) the relative {NAME}/{PRODUCTID}/{PRODUCTPICURL} bindings resolve against. Same data, same leaf names, renders identically — the List's binding attribute is dropped.

ProductPicUrl is stored as the absolute https://sdk.openui5.org/test-resources/sap/ui/documentation/sdk/images/HT-1000.jpg (the mock's host-relative test-resources path rewritten to the OpenUI5 host per the runtime asset-URL rule).
